name: ICAN / ICANIAN SN04 full-suspension fat-bike frameset
why_interesting: Official ICAN evidence identifies a 120 mm full-suspension fat-bike frame, contradicting the imported 100 mm soft-tail classification; the repository's fixed road/gravel allowance cannot represent an honest complete build.
missing: Resolve manufacturer conflicts in frame weight and carbon lay-up
Exact category and frameset package; official evidence excludes fork and shock
MTB-appropriate flat-bar complete-build specification and cost
Exact current mainland SKU, purchase route, warranty and return terms
source_note: Current exact ICAN evidence supports 26x4.8 tire fit with a 26x4.0 limit for size 16 and qualitative front-end stiffness. Current manufacturer pages conflict on both frame weight and carbon lay-up, so those values remain unresolved.

facts.tire_clearance: 26×4.8 maximum for sizes 18/20; 26×4.0 maximum for size 16; exact product also lists 29×2.25-3.0 and 27.5×3.0-3.25 options
facts.tire_clearance_basis: Current exact manufacturer product and collection pages; nominal tire sizes
facts.frame_weight_status: Current manufacturer conflict: 2,560 g versus 2,507 g and 2,057 +/- 40 g
facts.frame_material_status: Current manufacturer conflict: Toray T700 versus T700/T800
facts.stiffness_evidence: Exact-model manufacturer pages claim improved stiffness and tapered-headtube front-end stiffness; qualitative evidence without a numeric protocol
